findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 3 picture(s) on the page (3 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 3 text element(s) use mix-blend-mode difference or exclusion.
findings.fix: Over anything but black, white or grey, blended text takes random hues (blue on orange, lilac on green) that jurors read as a glitch. Use a solid ink chosen for the ground, or keep the blended text over neutral grounds only.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it has no size yet).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 29px from the left edge but only to 180px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: 6 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 420px at 1276px; 444px at 2052px; 428px at 3360px; 500px at 5488px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The page has no visible h1.
findings.fix: Give the first screen a clear title in an h1 that says what this is (a name with what it does, the product with what it is for, the event with its date and place).

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "SENAI" (screen 11, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Only 4 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 3 of 11 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 3, 4, 7.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "MON–FRI, 9AM–6PM EST" → 3 lines (3 words, 73.7px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 365px of the width empty: "Questions".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "SENAI TECHNOLOGY, OPENSLOT" → 3 lines (3 words, 32px); "MON–FRI, 9AM–6PM EST" → 3 lines (3 words, 37.4px)
